name: Smart Ad Engine with Report
author: Code and core

sections.description:
Smart Ad Engine with Report is the ultimate all-in-one advertising solution designed to help you seamlessly manage, schedule, and track advertisements on your WordPress website. Whether you are running custom banner ads, Google AdSense, Amazon Associates, or affiliate links, this plugin provides the professional tools you need to maximize your ad revenue and monitor performance—all without slowing down your site.

Designed for both beginners and advanced users, it takes the guesswork out of ad management. Set up your campaigns in minutes and let our intelligent engine handle the rotation and tracking!

Key Features:

  • Advanced Ad Scheduling: Set precise start and end dates/times for your campaigns. Control which days of the week and exact hours of the day ads should be visible. Maximize conversions by showing ads when your audience is most active.
  • Intelligent Rotation Modes: Display ads sequentially, randomly, dynamically (reloading after a set interval), or in blocks/grids to prevent ad blindness and keep your content fresh.
  • Detailed Analytics & Tracking: Track real-time impressions and clicks for each advertisement, complete with insightful, visually appealing graphs directly in your WordPress dashboard.
  • Automated Email Reports: Get daily or weekly performance overviews delivered straight to your inbox, along with campaign expiry alerts so you never miss an opportunity.
  • Shortcode & Widget Support: Easily place ads anywhere on your site using intuitive shortcodes, PHP snippets, or standard WordPress widgets. Seamlessly integrates with any theme.
  • Lightweight & Blazing Fast: Built strictly following the latest WordPress coding standards to ensure maximum security, compatibility, and zero impact on your Core Web Vitals or page load speed.
  • Fully Responsive: Ensure your ads look stunning on desktops, tablets, and mobile devices alike.

Perfect For:

  • Bloggers & Content Creators: Monetize your traffic effectively with highly targeted responsive ads.
  • Affiliate Marketers: Rotate affiliate links to identify and promote the highest-converting offers.
  • Publishers & News Sites: Manage direct ad sales and display premium sponsor banners with full reporting capabilities.

Take complete control of your advertising space with Smart Ad Engine with Report and start optimizing your ad placements effortlessly!

Privacy & Data Collection

This plugin respects your privacy. Both the diagnostic tracking and deactivation feedback features are 100% optional.

Telemetry & Diagnostics (Opt-in Only)

Upon activation, you will be invited to share anonymous site diagnostics. This is strictly opt-in and can be disabled at any time from the ‘Privacy’ tab in Settings. If you agree, we collect:

  • WordPress, PHP, and Plugin version numbers.
  • Theme name/version and locale.
  • Multisite status and a hashed site identifier.

No personal data, user information, or site content is collected.

Deactivation Feedback

If you decide to deactivate the plugin, a feedback modal will appear. Providing feedback is entirely optional — you can click “Skip & Deactivate” to deactivate the plugin immediately without sharing any data. You may optionally share your name and email address if you wish to be contacted for support.

Data Security

All collected data is encrypted using AES-256-CBC before being transmitted to our secure receiver server.

External Services

This plugin connects to external APIs operated by Code and Core to support optional telemetry diagnostics and optional deactivation feedback. Both services are entirely opt-in / optional.

1. Telemetry / Diagnostics Receiver

This plugin connects to an API to send anonymous site-health data, needed to help prioritize compatibility updates. It sends the Site URL, plugin name & version, PHP version, WordPress version, active theme name & version, site language, multisite status, and a Unix timestamp every time the plugin is activated, deactivated, or updated — ONLY if the administrator has explicitly opted in.

This service is provided by Code and Core: https://codeandcore.com/privacy-policy/

2. Deactivation Feedback Receiver

This plugin connects to an API to receive voluntary feedback when a site administrator chooses to share a reason for deactivating the plugin. It sends: deactivation reason, optional details, Site URL, plugin name & version, PHP version, WordPress version, active theme name & version, site language, multisite status, and a timestamp — ONLY when the administrator clicks “Submit Feedback” in the deactivation modal. Name and email are sent only if the contact checkbox is checked.

This service is provided by Code and Core: https://codeandcore.com/privacy-policy/

All data transmitted to endpoints on wordpress-plugins.pro is encrypted with AES-256-CBC before sending.
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin zip file.
  2. Log in to your WordPress administrative panel.
  3. Go to Plugins > Add New and click on the Upload Plugin button.
  4. Select the downloaded smart-ad-engine-with-report.zip file and click Install Now.
  5. Once installed, click Activate.
  6. A new menu item Smart Ad Engine with Report will appear in your admin dashboard.
  7. Go to Smart Ad Engine with Report > Global Settings to configure your initial preferences and you’re ready to create ads!
sections.faq:
How do I display an ad on a page or post?

You can display ads by creating an Ad Group and pasting its generated shortcode (e.g., [smaraden_group id="1"]) anywhere in your content, or by using the Smart Ad Engine with Report widget in your sidebars.

Can I use Google AdSense with this plugin?

Yes, absolutely! You can place AdSense by using the supported ad types without requiring arbitrary script insertion.

Does this plugin track clicks and impressions?

Yes! Smart Ad Engine with Report includes built-in statistics tracking. You can view detailed charts of impressions and clicks for individual ads and groups directly from the admin dashboard.

Can I schedule ads to run only on weekends?

Absolutely. The scheduling system allows you to pick specific start and end dates, define exact daily hours, and select which days of the week the ad should run.

Is it compatible with caching plugins?

Yes. Smart Ad Engine with Report is designed to work alongside popular caching plugins like W3 Total Cache, WP Rocket, and LiteSpeed Cache. Dynamic features like click tracking utilize non-cached AJAX endpoints to ensure accuracy.

Will this slow down my website?

No. Smart Ad Engine with Report is built with performance in mind. Database queries are highly optimized and cached, and the front-end rendering adds virtually zero overhead to your page load times.

Does it support responsive ads?

Yes, the plugin is fully compatible with responsive ad units (including responsive AdSense banners). Your ads will automatically adapt to fit perfectly on mobile, tablet, and desktop screens.

How are the performance reports sent to my email?

The plugin utilizes WordPress’s built-in WP-Cron system to compile and send automated email reports. You can choose a daily or weekly schedule and customize the recipient email addresses directly in the Global Settings.

Is there a limit to the number of ads or campaigns I can create?

No, there are no artificial limits. You can create as many individual ads, ad groups, and schedules as your server resources allow.

  • Added core ad management, groups, and rotation logic.
  • Added comprehensive scheduling features.
  • Implemented built-in statistics tracking and automated email reporting.
  • Ensured strict adherence to WordPress coding standards and security best practices.

Ad Edit (Advanced Settings) - Set up quotas, targeting, and advanced display conditions.
Ad Placement Groups - Overview of all your ad groups.
Group Edit - Configure grid layouts, rotation modes, and fallback ads for a group.
Ad Display Schedules - Overview of all active, paused, and expired schedules.
Schedule Edit - Create detailed time, date, and day-of-week schedules for your campaigns.
Statistics Dashboard - Comprehensive dashboard with charts and overall performance metrics.
Click Stats - Detailed log of individual ad clicks, IPs, and visitor information.

Global Settings (Maintenance) - Options for database cleanup and security.
